about_the_game:
Laundromat Manager Simulator - Demo

Get a sneak peek into Laundromat Manager Simulator with this exclusive demo! Experience the core mechanics of running a laundromat as you operate machines and provide essential laundry services to customers.

Operate Washing Machines & Dryers

Manage a selection of washers and dryers to keep customers satisfied and business running smoothly.

Deliver Laundry Services

Ensure every load is cleaned efficiently and on time—customer satisfaction is key to success!

This demo offers a glimpse into the full Laundromat Manager Simulator experience, where you’ll eventually expand your business, upgrade equipment, and design the ultimate laundromat. Are you ready to take the first step in becoming a laundry tycoon?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 4690 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 / RX 570 (4GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 8700K / AMD r5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 / RX 6700 (8GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
